description: Netlify site connector (read-only). Surfaces site id, name, the production URL + SSL URL, the admin dashboard URL, the linked git repo + branch, and the embedded published-deploy status (state / branch / commit ref / commit URL / deploy preview URL) into the local index as `netlify:site` items — useful for answering "is the latest deploy live?" and "which site shipped this commit?". Bearer-token (PAT) auth. The SaaS host (api.netlify.com) is fixed. Per-deploy history, forms, functions, env vars, and DNS are deferred follow-ups.
author: Nimbus
